messages:
maria.chen: We pulled community/x2-7b into scout bucket s3://redwood-models/scout/x2-7b. Need someone to run provenance checks and prepare registry entry before we start quant experiments. Who can own initial verification?
arjun.patel: I can take ownership for the verification pass. Quick agreed checklist?
maria.chen: Rough checklist to start: 
- verify weights checksums (sha256)
- validate tokenizer files + vocab version
- ensure envelope encryption w/ KMS during transfer
- run lightweight sanity eval (ppx + safety smoke)
- draft quant plan (PTQ baseline, later GPTQ/QAT)
- prepare registry metadata (license, source url, commit hash, manifest checksum)
- write provenance notes (origin, downloader, attestations)
zoe.kim: Add tokenization fuzz tests (control tokens, edge unicode) and capture 20 sample prompts + reference outputs for eval harness.
infra-bot: s3://redwood-models/scout/x2-7b bucket policy check: public-read disabled — OK.
arjun.patel: First commands I will run locally: 
```
sha256sum weights/*.bin > /tmp/x2-7b.weights.sha256
python -c "import json; print('vocab_len=', len(json.load(open('tokenizer/vocab.json'))))"
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-models/scout/x2-7b/ ./local_x2-7b/ --no-sign-request
```
Note: if upstream is private we'll ask for presigned links instead of open pull.
ravi.singh: I'll own checksum + tokenizer verification today, ETA 15:00 PT.
mateo.gomez: Registry required fields: model_id, version, license, source_uri, commit_hash, manifest_checksum, tokenizer_checksum, recommended_quant_profile, provenance_notes. Also include a small "smoke_prompt_set" pointer.
arjun.patel: Quant plan suggestion: baseline 8-bit PTQ (bitsandbytes) to measure perf; run 4-bit GPTQ on a small shard of weights for mem/latency tradeoffs. Track: perplexity, helm eval (QA/LLM-specific), token-latency, memory footprint.
zoe.kim: Quality gates proposal: fail onboarding if avg ppx regresses >5% vs anchor OR hallucination rate increases by >3%. Need these to be enforced in CI and P0 alerts wired.
maria.chen: After checks pass we create manifest + registry entry and tag it onboarding:scout. Who can own canary infra + routing knobs?
mateo.gomez: I'll own canary policies and cost caps. Suggest Dedicated trial autoscale min=1 max=4, fallback to smaller variant if latency >200ms p95. Also add cost alarm to avoid runaway egress.
arjun.patel: Pushing a manifest PR after local checks. PR will include weights list + sha256, tokenizer checksum, manifest.json, recommended quant profile, and provenance_notes.
zoe.kim: :thumbsup: storing eval seeds, logs, sample prompts under s3://redwood-models/scout/x2-7b/evals/. Will include human eval snippets for earliest QA.
maria.chen: Security note — if customer-managed KMS keys are used for this model, open a security ticket for rotation policy and attestation.
sec-bot: Reminder: submit KMS rotation ticket to #security-ops if using customer-managed keys.
arjun.patel: Found tokenizer vocab mismatch: 50260 vs expected 50257. Investigating whether extra special tokens were included.
zoe.kim: Quick check: maybe upstream included additional control tokens. Run: python -c \"import json; print(len(json.load(open('tokenizer/vocab.json'))))\" and diff with tokenizer config.
maria.chen: If diff is only special tokens, record in provenance and proceed unless tokenization semantics change outputs.
arjun.patel: Upstream fixed tokenizer and re-uploaded. Updated weights manifest with sha256: abcdef1234567890deadbeefcafebabe... (shortened in PR). PR: https://git.redwood/models/registry/pulls/456
maria.chen: Great. Moving to onboarding queue as scout/x2-7b. Recommended quant profile: ptq-8b-dynamic. If regressions appear, fallback to verified open variant and halt rollout. Ping #eng-ml for any new issues.
mateo.gomez: Noted — I'll schedule canary for next maintenance window and set cost cap alerts.
arjun.patel: Closing verification pass in my checklist and marking PR ready for review.
zoe.kim: I'll attach tokenization fuzz logs + eval samples to the PR.
maria.chen: Thanks everyone — solid handoff. Keep provenance notes concise but explicit (downloader, date, checksums, tokenizer diffs).
